[LADP.6.8.1] Lifecycle events worth matching on:

| Event | Author writes |
|---|---|
| Entity unavailable | `where s.state == "unavailable"` |
| Entity unknown | `where s.state == "unknown"` |
| Fresh (not just-learned) | `where not t.retained` (MQTT) — see [LADP.8] |
| No entity present | `no <Schema> <binding>` ([LGRA.8.1]) — but see [LADP.7.4.1] |
